text:
Hannah Lee: Quick draft  of a one-page manager checklist + short self-review template for the upcoming performance cycle. Goal: make reviews 3x faster and increase clarity. Draft link: https://notion.redwood/quick-review-guide (WIP)

Devon Park: Nice. Keep self-review to 3 bullets max: 1) Top contribution + metric, 2) Biggest lesson, 3) What I need next.

Ravi Singh: For peer feedback, propose 3 one-line prompts: Strength, Outcome, Suggestion. Example: 'Strength: shipped X; Outcome: reduced latency by 30%; Suggestion: share runbook.'

Hannah Lee: Adding manager micro-rubric (1 line each): Exceeded = >1 measurable outcome or enabled team; Met = delivered expected scope; Below = missed key commitments.

Devon Park: Small ask: include a short prompt for managers to call out cross-team influence when relevant. Helps calibration.

Hannah Lee: Done. Also added a checkbox on the form: 'Not applicable (skip leadership questions)'.

PeopleOps Bot: Resource uploaded: /handbooks/perf-cycle/quick-checklist-2026.md 1769130299 (uploaded by Hannah Lee).

Ravi Singh: Can we pilot with infra and growth this week? I'll collect ~8 samples and share.

Hannah Lee: Sounds good . Action: finalize by 1769128800, run 4 business days, reconvene with samples. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
